components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Black pill; the one main action per view, in the thumb zone.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 3rem; padding: 0 1.25rem; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; font: 500 1rem/1 ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), opacity 0.2s; } .ds-btn:active:not(:disabled) { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: default; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--fg, #0d0d0d); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--fg, #0d0d0d); color: var(--bg, #ffffff); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Paper pill with hairline border for the secondary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 3rem; padding: 0 1.25rem; border: 1px solid var(--line, rgb(0 0 0 / 0.08)); border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--bg, #ffffff); color: var(--fg, #0d0d0d); font: 500 1rem/1 ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--fg, #0d0d0d); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: 44px round hit area; surface fill on press.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-icon" aria-label="Back"><svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="m15 18-6-6 6-6"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-icon { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 2.75rem; height: 2.75rem; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; color: var(--fg, #0d0d0d); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-icon:active { background: var(--surface, #f4f4f4); } .ds-btn-icon:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--fg, #0d0d0d); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Field
components.description: Hairline field, 1rem radius, border darkens on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; width: 100%; min-height: 3rem; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--line, rgb(0 0 0 / 0.08)); border-radius: 1rem; background: var(--bg, #ffffff); color: var(--fg, #0d0d0d); font: 400 1rem/1.5 ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; appearance: none; } .ds-field::placeholder { color: var(--faint, #737373); } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--muted, #5d5d5d); }

components.name: Top Bar
components.description: Sticky 3.5rem bar: back chevron, truncated 17px title.
components.html: Anna's 30th
components.css: .ds-topbar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.25rem; height: 3.5rem; padding: 0 0.5rem; background: var(--bg, #ffffff); color: var(--fg, #0d0d0d); font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-topbar-back { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 2.75rem; height: 2.75rem; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; color: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-topbar-back:active { background: var(--surface, #f4f4f4); } .ds-topbar-back:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--fg, #0d0d0d); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-topbar-title { flex: 1; min-width: 0; padding: 0 0.5rem; overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Bottom Bar
components.description: Thumb-zone action bar with a hairline top rule.
components.css: .ds-bottombar { display: flex; gap: 0.5rem; max-width: 32rem; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--line, rgb(0 0 0 / 0.08)); background: var(--bg, #ffffff); } .ds-bottombar-btn { flex: 1; height: 3rem; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--fg, #0d0d0d); color: var(--bg, #ffffff); font: 500 1rem/1 ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-bottombar-btn:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-bottombar-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--fg, #0d0d0d); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Bottom Sheet
components.description: Dialog sheet from the bottom edge: 1.75rem top corners, pill grabber.
components.html:
Invite guests

Show this code or QR.

components.description: Borderless list row: 3.5rem thumbnail, surface on press.
components.html: Anna's 30th148 photos
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; padding: 0.5rem; border-radius: 1rem; color: var(--fg, #0d0d0d); text-decoration: none; font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-row:active { background: var(--surface, #f4f4f4); } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--fg, #0d0d0d); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-row-thumb { width: 3.5rem; height: 3.5rem; flex-shrink: 0; border-radius: 0.75rem; background: var(--surface, #f4f4f4); } .ds-row-title { display: block; font-weight: 500; } .ds-row-meta { display: block; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--muted, #5d5d5d); }

components.name: Print
components.description: Signature: white paper photo with an even border and soft print shadow, tilted on the gray table; the pile flips itself every 1.5s.
components.css: .ds-table { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 2rem; background: var(--surface, #f4f4f4); } .ds-print { display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 12rem; aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; padding: 3.5%; border-radius: 0.375rem; background: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.08), 0 14px 32px -10px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.3); transform: rotate(3deg); transition: transform 0.55s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-print:hover { transform: rotate(-2deg); } .ds-print:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0d0d0d; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-print-photo { flex: 1; min-height: 0; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e8b04b, #c2416b); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-print { transition: none; } }

narrative.overview:
RollCall is a quiet monochrome phone app in the spirit of ChatGPT's interface: white (or near-black) ground, one black pill for the action that matters, hairline borders, soft rounded corners, system type. The chrome has no colour of its own, so the only colour anywhere is in people's photos. The interface is the table and the photos are what lands on it.

Density is phone-native and one-handed. Content sits in one column no wider than 32rem. Primary actions are pinned in the thumb zone above the home indicator, and the edges respect the safe areas. Depth comes from flat tonal steps (`bg` to `surface`) and 1px lines, never from shadows on chrome. The one material exception is the print: a white paper photo with a real soft shadow, used where the product wants to feel like a pile of shared photos.

Light and dark follow the system setting. Each token has a dark twin, and nothing is hard-coded to one scheme except the print paper, the full-bleed photo viewer and the QR plate, which need to stay white or black whatever the scheme.
keyCharacteristics: Black / white / gray chrome only; photos carry all colour.
9999px pills for actions, 1rem to 1.75rem radii for containers.
System sans everywhere; system mono only for join codes.
One motion curve, exponential ease-out, switched off under reduced motion.
Mobile-first single column (max 32rem), safe-area aware, thumb-zone actions.

rules.name: The Photos Are The Only Colour Rule
rules.body: No hue goes into chrome, ever: no accent, no tinted state, no coloured badge. If something needs emphasis, use Ink, weight, or the black pill. Colour on screen comes from user photos (and, on the login pile, licensed stock prints).

rules.name: The Twin Token Rule
rules.body: Every chrome colour comes from a token with a dark twin. A literal value is only allowed for objects that are physically the same colour in both schemes (print paper, viewer, QR plate).

rules.name: The Native Voice Rule
rules.body: Use the system stacks only. Get emphasis from weight (500 / 600 / 700), not from a second family.

rules.name: The Flat Chrome Rule
rules.body: Buttons, fields, cards and bars never cast shadows. Only popovers and paper prints do.

rules.name: The Shaded Paper Rule
rules.body: On a pile, lower prints dim the photo only (brightness 0.86 / 0.91 / 0.96 / 1 by depth). The white paper border is never shaded.

dos: Do make the one primary action a black pill (Ink fill, 9999px, 3rem tall) in the thumb zone.
Do draw every border as a 1px `line` hairline (8% / 10% alpha).
Do use `--ease-out-expo` (`cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`) for every transition, and turn it off under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
Do keep touch targets at least 44px (2.75rem) and inputs at 16px.
Do pair every chrome colour with its dark-mode twin.
Do let photos fill their frames (`object-cover`) and keep everything around them gray.
donts: Don't add any hue to chrome: no accent colour, coloured badge or tinted state. Photos are the only colour.
Don't put shadows on buttons, fields, rows or bars. Shadows belong to popovers and prints only.
Don't introduce a second type family or a webfont. Use the system sans, plus system mono for codes.
Don't use sharp corners on chrome. Only the paper print goes near-square (0.375rem).
Don't shade a print's paper border. Depth dims the photo only.
